beats.line: Sirf WhatsApp Business mein greeting aur quick replies set karna kaafi lagta hai?

Chatbot ko WhatsApp se jodte hain, jo 24x7 reply karta hai; quick replies se naam‑number lete hain, taaki record ho jaye.

master_script.linkedin_english: Many small businesses lose WhatsApp leads because they can't reply quickly. An AI chatbot can automatically answer enquiries, ask for name and number, and store them in a CRM. Comment “BOT” to receive a checklist of the essential questions your bot should handle.

marketing.gets: a one-page checklist: the 10 questions a WhatsApp reply bot should answer for your business, so you can see if it fits

facts.claim: 55% of WhatsApp leads arrived without a mobile number, making it hard to follow up.
facts.title: Implementation of the Month: How a University in Lima Captures WhatsApp Leads That Arrive Without a Phone Number Using AI and Zoho –...

facts.claim: WhatsApp chats are not a database, so businesses should copy essential details like name and number into a shared sheet or CRM.
facts.title: How can businesses organise WhatsApp enquiries? Darsh Innovations

facts.claim: Using quick replies that ask the two or three essential questions you always need answered helps capture name and contact number early in the conversation.
facts.title: How can businesses organise WhatsApp enquiries? Darsh Innovations

facts.claim: A simple WhatsApp CRM for small businesses should track name and WhatsApp number as core fields.
facts.title: WhatsApp CRM for Indian small businesses: a simple setup — KutrimBots

facts.claim: Qualify leads in the first three messages by asking two qualifiers – what the prospect is trying to solve and who will decide – to filter and capture details quickly.
facts.title: WhatsApp lead capture: turning conversations into qualified pipeline LeadManagement

facts.claim: WhatsApp chat lists are sorted by the latest message, not by buyer readiness, causing hot leads to sink below newer chats and leading to missed follow‑ups and missing information.
facts.title: WhatsApp CRM for Indian small businesses: a simple setup — KutrimBots

facts.claim: Pre‑filling the initial WhatsApp message with context (e.g., "Hi, I'd like a quote for {product}") tells the sales team the prospect’s intent before the chat starts.
facts.title: WhatsApp lead capture: turning conversations into qualified pipeline LeadManagement

facts.claim: Switching from personal WhatsApp to the free WhatsApp Business app provides a business profile, labels, quick replies, and greeting messages that help structure enquiries and capture contact details.
facts.title: How can businesses organise WhatsApp enquiries? Darsh Innovations
